title: 第29章 家的感觉
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
陆沉的洞府之中。

    姜怀玉推门走进陆沉的房间。

    此刻，玉凝正瘫在那里，疯狂吸收手中的一块高级灵石。

    “嗯？你怎么状态这么好？他…不恨你吗？”

    玉凝闻言，脸上羞红。

    “当然恨我了，可我是玉灵体，防御性比较高，即便我不用灵力抵挡，他也不太能对我造成太大伤害，我真的尽力了！”

    “难怪你修行的速度这么快，原来是有特殊体质！”姜怀玉眼中闪过一丝艳羡。

    特殊体质一般都有各种各样好处，其中玉灵体就是防御力高，和灵石的共鸣强烈，可以轻易吸收其中的灵气并完美炼化。

    所以玉凝的修为比较高。

    “那按理说，你早就应该突破到元婴了，为什么现在还是金丹圆满？”

    “我……我有心结！”

    玉凝此话一出，姜怀玉瞬间就懂了。

    因为孩子不是亲生的，所以一直担惊受怕，这和她之前是一样的。

    “甚至，小宝的体质遗传了陆郎的金灵根和我的玉灵体，乃是变异的金玉体，我都不敢告诉张帆！”

    昨天陆沉给玉凝见到了不一样的风景和折腾，她自然而然就叫陆郎了。

    “金玉体？比你的体质还要厉害？师妹你可真是好福气！”

    “哎呀～师姐就别再打趣人家了～”

    “那你现在呢？还有心结吗？”

    “没，没有了，和张帆和离，被他赶走的时候，我甚至没感觉到太大的痛苦，只感觉到了解脱！”玉凝叹了一口气。

    “那，他除了……”

    “别说了师姐，凝儿从来就没这么……”玉凝说着就不好意思了。

    她现在算是明白了，为什么姜怀玉被陆沉打成那样，也愿意继续在这里了。

    她也愿意。

    “既然如此，那咱们就好好在这里过日子，再有十个月，你估计又要生一胎了，就是不知道会不会再次继承你的体质！”
content_en:
In Lu Chen's cave.

Jiang Huaiyu pushed the door open and walked into Lu Chen's room.

At this moment, Yu Ning was paralyzed there, frantically absorbing a high-level spiritual stone in her hand.

"Huh? Why are you in such good condition? Doesn't he... hate you?"

When Yu Ning heard this, her face turned red with embarrassment.

"Of course he hates me, but I am a jade spirit body with relatively high defense. Even if I don't use my spiritual power to resist, he won't be able to cause much harm to me. I really tried my best!"

"No wonder you practice so fast, it turns out you have a special physique!" A trace of envy flashed in Jiang Huaiyu's eyes.

Special physiques generally have various benefits. Among them, the jade spirit body has high defense and resonates strongly with the spiritual stone. It can easily absorb the spiritual energy in it and refine it perfectly.

Therefore, Yu Ning's cultivation level is relatively high.

"Then it stands to reason that you should have broken through to the Nascent Soul long ago. Why are you still perfecting the Golden Core now?"

"I...I have a knot in my heart!"

As soon as Yu Ning said this, Jiang Huaiyu understood it instantly.

Because the child is not her biological child, she has always been frightened, just like she did before.

"In fact, Xiaobao's physique inherited Lu Lang's golden spiritual root and my jade spiritual body. It is a mutated golden and jade body. I dare not tell Zhang Fan!"

Yesterday, Lu Chen showed Yu Ning different scenery and hardships, so she naturally called him Lu Lang.

"Golden jade body? Even more powerful than yours? Junior sister, you are so lucky!"

"Oh~ Senior sister, please stop teasing me~"

"What about you now? Do you still have knots in your heart?"

"No, no more. When I made peace with Zhang Fan and was driven away by him, I didn't even feel much pain. I only felt relief!" Yu Ning sighed.

"Then, besides..."

"Stop talking, senior sister, Ning'er has never been like this..." Yu Ning said, feeling embarrassed.

She now understood why Jiang Huaiyu was beaten like that by Lu Chen, and she was willing to stay here.

She is willing too.

"In that case, let's live a good life here. In ten months, you will probably have another baby. I just don't know if I will inherit your physique again!"
